name: Gapify AI Customer Communication
author: gapify

sections.description:
Gapify AI Customer Communication connects your WordPress website to Gapify, an AI-first customer communication platform that revolutionizes how businesses interact with their customers.

🤖 AI-Powered Customer Support

Botify, Gapify’s intelligent AI chatbot, automatically handles customer inquiries with smart, contextual responses. This means:

  • Increase Revenue: AI provides personalized shopping advice and product recommendations
  • Reduce Costs: Decrease dependency on human support agents with automated responses
  • 24/7 Availability: Never miss a customer inquiry, even outside business hours
  • Smart Conversations: Context-aware AI understands customer intent and provides relevant help

🚀 Key Benefits

  • Revenue Growth: AI-driven shopping assistance converts more visitors to customers
  • Cost Reduction: Automated responses handle routine inquiries without human intervention
  • Enhanced Experience: Instant, intelligent responses improve customer satisfaction
  • Scalable Support: Handle unlimited conversations simultaneously

⚡ WordPress Integration Features

  • One-Click Setup: Enter your Gapify website token and go live instantly
  • Smart User Identification: Automatically identify WordPress users for personalized service
  • Advanced Display Rules: Control exactly when and where the AI assistant appears
  • Multi-language Support: Serve customers in their preferred language
  • Role-Based Control: Customize chat availability based on user roles
  • Mobile Optimized: Perfect experience across all devices

🎯 Perfect For

  • E-commerce Stores: AI shopping assistant increases sales and reduces cart abandonment
  • SaaS Businesses: Automated onboarding and feature guidance
  • Service Providers: Instant quote generation and appointment scheduling
  • Educational Platforms: AI tutoring and course support
  • Any Business: Looking to scale customer support without increasing costs

Advanced Configuration

  • Position Control: Left or right side positioning
  • Theme Integration: Light, dark, or auto theme detection
  • Widget Styling: Standard or flat design options
  • Message Bubble: Show/hide message notifications
  • Popout Button: Optional popout functionality
  • Base Domain: Cookie domain configuration for multi-domain setups

User Identification

Automatically pass WordPress user information to your Gapify dashboard:

  • User ID or email as identifier
  • Display name and avatar
  • Email address
  • Phone number (from user meta)
  • Custom user data

Display Rules

Fine-tune when your chat widget appears:

  • Role-Based Hiding: Hide from administrators, editors, or any user role
  • Post Type Exclusion: Exclude from products, pages, or custom post types
  • URL Pattern Matching: Use wildcards to exclude specific URLs
  • Guest User Control: Special handling for non-logged-in users

Developer Friendly

  • Clean, well-documented code
  • WordPress coding standards compliant
  • Extensive hooks and filters
  • Comprehensive test suite
  • SOLID principles architecture

Privacy Policy

This plugin may collect and transmit user data to Gapify servers when user identification is enabled. The data transmitted includes:

  • User ID or email (as configured)
  • Display name (if enabled)
  • Email address (if enabled)
  • Avatar URL (if enabled)
  • Phone number (if enabled and available)

This data is only sent when:
1. User identification is explicitly enabled in settings
2. A user is logged into WordPress
3. The chat widget is displayed

No data is collected or transmitted without explicit configuration. Review the Gapify Privacy Policy and ensure compliance with your local privacy requirements.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports:

  • Visit the WordPress.org support forum
  • Contact Gapify support through your dashboard
  • Check our documentation

License

This plugin is licensed under the GNU General Public License v2 or later.

Open Source Distribution:
This plugin is released under GPL v2 to comply with WordPress.org requirements and to ensure users have the freedom to use, study, modify, and distribute the software.

Commercial Use:
While this plugin is open source under GPL v2, Gapify may offer additional commercial licensing terms for enterprise customers or those requiring proprietary modifications. Contact gapify.ai for commercial licensing inquiries.

Third-Party Service:
This plugin connects to Gapify’s cloud-based AI customer communication platform. Use of Gapify services requires a separate account and is subject to Gapify’s terms of service at gapify.ai/terms.

About Gapify

Gapify is a modern customer support platform that helps businesses provide exceptional customer service through live chat, email, and other communication channels.

Learn more at gapify.ai
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Gapify Live Chat”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload it to your WordPress site via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Go to Settings > Gapify AI Customer Communication
  2. Enter your Gapify website token (get it from app.gapify.ai)
  3. Configure your AI assistant preferences
  4. Save changes

Your intelligent AI assistant (Botify) will now be available on your website 24/7!

Getting Your Gapify Account

New to Gapify?
– Visit gapify.ai to learn about our AI-first customer communication platform
– Sign up at app.gapify.ai to create your account
– Train Botify (our AI assistant) with your business knowledge
– Connect additional channels like Instagram, WhatsApp, and more
sections.faq:
What is Gapify and how does it work?

Gapify is an AI-first customer communication platform featuring Botify, an intelligent AI chatbot that automatically handles customer inquiries. It increases revenue through personalized shopping advice and reduces costs by automating customer support.

Where do I get my website token?

  1. Sign up at app.gapify.ai
  2. In your dashboard, go to Integrations > Website Widget
  3. Copy your unique website token
  4. Paste it into the WordPress plugin settings

How does the AI assistant increase revenue?

Botify provides personalized shopping recommendations, answers product questions instantly, reduces cart abandonment, and guides customers through the purchase process – all automatically, 24/7.

Can I train the AI for my specific business?

Yes! In your Gapify dashboard at app.gapify.ai, you can train Botify with your product knowledge, FAQs, and business-specific information.

What other channels can I connect?

Besides WordPress websites, Gapify connects to Instagram, WhatsApp, email, and other communication channels from a single dashboard.

Can I hide the AI assistant on specific pages?

Yes! Use the “Display Rules” section to:
– Hide on specific post types (products, pages, etc.)
– Exclude URLs using wildcard patterns
– Hide from specific user roles
– Control exactly where your AI assistant appears

Does it work with WooCommerce and e-commerce?

Absolutely! Gapify is particularly powerful for e-commerce, providing AI-powered shopping assistance, product recommendations, and sales support that can significantly increase conversion rates.

Is my data secure?

Yes, Gapify follows enterprise-grade security standards. The plugin only shares data you explicitly configure, and all communications are encrypted.

Do I need coding skills to set this up?

No! Simply install the plugin, enter your website token, and your AI assistant goes live. Advanced features can be configured through the user-friendly Gapify dashboard.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

Release Date – December 2024

  • PHP 7.4+ compatibility improvements
  • ✅ Removed mixed type declarations for broader PHP compatibility
  • ✅ Maintained all modern PHP features (typed properties, constructor promotion)
  • ✅ Preserved SOLID principles and clean code architecture
  • ✅ Enhanced WordPress.org plugin directory compatibility

1.0.1

Release Date – December 2024

  • WordPress.org compliance improvements
  • ✅ Enhanced security with proper output escaping
  • ✅ WordPress script enqueuing standards implementation
  • ✅ Input sanitization for $_SERVER variables
  • ✅ WordPress alternative functions usage (wp_parse_url)
  • ✅ GPL v2 dual licensing implementation
  • ✅ WordPress 6.8 compatibility testing
  • ✅ Plugin directory optimization

1.0.0

Release Date – December 2024

  • Initial release
  • ✅ Basic widget integration and configuration
  • ✅ User identification and data passing
  • ✅ Advanced display rules and URL pattern matching
  • ✅ Multi-language support with auto-detection
  • ✅ Role-based visibility controls
  • ✅ Post type filtering
  • ✅ Comprehensive admin interface
  • ✅ Mobile-responsive design
  • ✅ WordPress 6.4 compatibility
  • ✅ PHP 8.0+ support
